/** * selectMngrMntrgSchdlList : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MngrMntrgSchdlMapper : 관리자모니터링일정목록조회 */ SELECT T1.CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /** 상담사아이디 **/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /** 상담사명 **/ , T1.MNGR_INPT_YMD AS MNGR_INPT_YMD /** 관리자입력일자 **/ , SUBSTR(T1.MNGR_INPT_YMD,0,6) AS CRTR_YM , T1.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /** 색인일련번호 **/ , T3.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO /** 유선전화번호 **/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T3.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /** 휴대전화번호암호화 **/ FROM AYC160 T1 , SAA200 T2 , SCA100 T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CNSLTNT_ID = T2.USER_ID AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T3.ENFSN_NO AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND T1.MNGR_INPT_YMD LIKE #{crtrYm} || '%'

/** * selectMngrMntrgSchdlDelInfo : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.selectMngrMntrgSchdlDelInfo : 관리자모니터링 삭제일정정보 조회 */ SELECT T1.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN FROM AYC160 T1 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T1.MNGR_INPT_YMD = #{mngrInptYmd}
mapper.insert: /** * insertMngrMntrgSchdl : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MngrMntrgSchdlMapper : 관리자모니터링일정목록 등록 */ INSERT INTO AYC160 /** 관리자 일정표 **/ ( INDEX_SN , CNSLTNT_ID , CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT , MNGR_INPT_YMD /** 관리자 입력일자 **/ , REG_YMD /** 등록일자 **/ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYC160_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{cnsltntId} , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{cnsltntNm}) , #{mngrInptYmd} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: /** * deleteMngrMntrgSchdl : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MngrMntrgSchdlMapper : 관리자모니터링일정목록 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC160 AA /** 관리자 일정표 **/ SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{indexSn}
